description: Express TypeScript API boilerplate with intentionally vulnerable framework configuration, unchecked request types, and reflected response rendering.

vulnerabilities.description: The query filter object's type and filter property are user-controlled without runtime type validation (Snyk: javascript/HTTPSourceWithUncheckedType, CWE-1287).
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: Improper Type Validation in query filter object can be tampered via HTTP Parameter Pollution leading to others types flowing into the search query in the sink

vulnerabilities.description: The query includes object's type and includes property are user-controlled without runtime type validation (Snyk: javascript/HTTPSourceWithUncheckedType, CWE-1287).
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: Improper Type Validation in query name field flows into sanitize XSS function without proper validation, leading to an XSS bypass in the response.

vulnerabilities.description: Mass Assignment allows an attacker to modify the user's profile data, including sensitive information like email and role, leading to unauthorized access and data breaches.
